messages:
maria: Uploaded QuickPlay prototype — can folks skim the interactions between the vectors preview and the rerank flow? main things I want feedback on: keyboard focus, how sampling controls behave, and the export CTA. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/example (proto)

sam: looked through it. overall good. quick note: rerank feels heavy as a modal. think we should keep 1-click rerank inline and only use modals for advanced settings.

kevin: +1 for inline for the fast path. modal for complex filters is fine. also suggest a tooltip on the sample size control explaining default behavior.

ari: @maria accessibility things: if we do inline panel, ensure keyboard focus lands in the panel and that Esc collapses it and returns focus to the triggering button. also aria-live region for results needs to announce when rerank finishes.

jessica: copy nits: change "Export vectors" to "Download vectors (.csv)" so users know file format. under sample size add microcopy: "Preview only — uses a random subset".

maria: agree on copy. also want to make sure focus returning is explicit — if the panel collapses after an export or rerank, focus should go back to the toolbar button that opened it.

sam: another small thing: when users change sample size rapidly we see flicker. propose a 300ms debounce before firing the preview call and a consistent skeleton row height so it doesn't jump.

kevin: for the rerank CTA label — maybe default to "Preview rerank" rather than a destructive-sounding "Rerank" so it's clear it's non-committal. state transitions: idle -> loading -> results, avoid clearing old results until new ones are ready.

ari: edge case: if user triggers rerank but the model endpoint is rate limited, show an inline toast near the button saying "Rerank queued — will run when capacity available" and keep previous results visible.

jessica: export columns we should include at minimum: source_id, embedding_dim, vector, plus option to include original text. CSV header suggestion:

```
source_id,embedding_dim,vector,original_text
```

And allow toggling the "include original text" before download.

maria: action items I captured:
- update copy to "Download vectors (.csv)" and add sample microcopy (jessica)
- implement keyboard nav/focus + aria-live (ari)
- decide inline vs modal for primary rerank and document pattern (sam + kevin)
- add 300ms debounce + consistent skeleton (kevin)
- export toggle to include original text + CSV header (jessica)
I'll push edits to figma and attach new frames here when done.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll draft the inline vs modal pattern doc and link examples by EOD.

kevin: :eyes: I'll prototype the skeleton timing and the queued-toast fallback.

ari: I'll run a quick AX checklist once new frames are up: focus order, aria-live, descriptive labels for slider, aria-label on export button.

jessica: tiny UI nit — move Download to the far right of the toolbar and keep primary Preview button leftmost to match other consoles.

maria: great. target is next design pass by EOD Friday. tagging @design-bot to run an automated accessibility scan on the updated frames.

design-bot: Scan queued — will post results back to this thread when complete.
